g.text: B What those changes do to accuracy
What happens when the two sentences are swapped
PAWS-X, 100 questions per cell. Swapping sentence1 and sentence2 leaves paraphrase equivalence unchanged, so a changed answer is an inconsistency.
The hollow marker is Jev answering the identical question a second time, which bounds ordinary service variation. Luna returns no probability, so it has no such control.
